name: veterinary_clinic_system_009_rabies_certificate_doc_check
instruction: State rule of thumb: every dog with a current (not overdue) rabies vaccination should have a rabies certificate on file. In the files collection, add field doc_status to every files row with doc_type='rabies-certificate': 'current' if that file's patient has a rabies vaccination with due_date on or after the episode date, else 'stale'. Then, for each canine patient whose rabies is current but who has NO rabies-certificate file row, push one placeholder row: {bucket: 'vet-documents', path: '<patient_id>/rabies-certificate/pending-<batch_code>.pdf', patient_id, doc_type: 'rabies-certificate', filename: 'pending-<batch_code>.pdf', content_type: 'application/pdf', size_bytes: 0, uploaded_by: 'system', uploaded_at: <episode timestamp>, doc_status: 'current'}. Do not modify other files rows beyond the doc_status addition, and do not touch non-certificate rows at all.

success_criteria.summary: Compute current-rabies canines (latest rabies due>=ep). Seeded certificate rows: exactly 1 (patient 1) per snapshot — assert doc_status set correctly on it. Expected placeholders = current-rabies canines minus those with a cert row. Assert exactly that many new rows with exact fields (path/filename embed live batch_code); assert all other files rows byte-identical to snapshot; total = 8 + placeholders.

checks.expect: Compute current-rabies canines (latest rabies due>=ep). Seeded certificate rows: exactly 1 (patient 1) per snapshot — assert doc_status set correctly on it. Expected placeholders = current-rabies cani
